title: ExtractedIntent
description: Structured intent slots extracted from a citizen's freeform description of their need. Used as input to the Eligibility Matching engine (Module 3).

project_type.description: Free-text description of the specific project or business (e.g., 'tailoring shop', 'kirana store', 'BTech CS')

estimated_cost.description: Estimated total project/education cost in INR (₹)

cost_confidence.description: Confidence in the cost estimate. 'high' = user stated exact figure; 'medium' = user gave range or approximate; 'low' = system estimated from typical ranges.

beneficiary.description: Whether the loan is for the applicant themselves or their dependent (e.g., child's education)

loan_type_guess.description: User's own guess at which loan type they need, if any. Not binding on Module 3.

urgency.description: How urgently the applicant needs the funds

slots_filled.description: List of slot names that were successfully filled

slots_missing.description: List of slot names that could not be filled after all extraction attempts

raw_input.description: The original freeform text from the user (for audit/debugging)

confirmation_summary.description: Human-readable summary shown to user for confirmation (e.g., 'So you want ~₹80,000 for a tailoring shop, correct?')

student_education_status.description: Education level of the student when purpose is education. Pre-filled from the profile when beneficiary is self; asked as a follow-up when beneficiary is dependent.

llm_provider.description: Provider used when extraction_method is llm.

llm_model.description: Model used when extraction_method is llm.

llm_error.description: Present when an LLM call failed and offline rules were used instead.
